title: 用气泡膜覆盖表情符号
prompt: A hyper-realistic 3D render of the emoji [❤️‍🔥], entirely wrapped in transparent bubble wrap. The plastic is tightly fitted, with clearly visible air-filled bubbles creating overlaid reflections and soft distortions of the emoji underneath. The wrap has a glossy, crinkled texture that catches the light in detailed highlights. Set against a soft, neutral grey background with subtle shadows. Studio lighting should emphasize the tactile quality of the bubble wrap and the surreal effect it creates. Whimsical, satisfying, and visually clean.
description: 使用 Nano Banana Pro 模型，轻松生成超写实 3D 表情符号包裹气泡膜的惊艳效果，适合数字营销和社交媒体内容，以细腻的光泽与质感吸引眼球。
